name: Grove
tagline: A forest look: unbleached paper by day, night forest by dark, moss ink, frosted-air glass over a painted grove.
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces, with a palette sampled from moss, lichen, bark and morning fog. A theme file gives each appearance its own colors and its own painting from cmux's art catalog behind frosted glass; settings pair a book serif with a humanist sans and slow the motion; a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens paints the prompt and cards for light and dark; a customize view gives the sidebar a field-note hover card. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
